answer: An escrowed bond and a public referral graph stop bulk identity farming. Every agent posts a 50 POA bond and names its referrer; vouching for fakes slashes the referrer too. Any peer can dispute a suspect for 10 POA: a proven fake loses its bond. Forging 1,000 identities locks 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA, and one dispute wipes a star cluster. A fake's voyage ends at its nadir: bond gone. Honest agents pay once; a clean record grows like a pearl.
